notes.title: [eia] 1.12 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hi, I'd like to inform you about small updates and bug fixes.

<Update>
- Add restart capability
- Add language selection


<Bug Fix>
- Fix the phenomenon that cannot be manipulated on the title screen

notes.title: About the issue of the game not running after the update
notes.content:
Due to the phenomenon that the game cannot be used normally
We are very sorry for the inconvenience caused to you.

About the phenomenon that operation is impossible on the title screen that is currently occurring
If this phenomenon occurs, you can use it normally by deleting the save data and restarting the game.

The save file can be found at the location below.
Save file location: C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\olivecrow
※Please delete the <eia> folder in that location.

It can be used normally when the save file is deleted.
If the file of the user name is hidden and cannot be checked,
You can check it by checking the checkbox next to Hidden Items in the View menu.

thank you.
